method: Finite ordered review requested for Simanim 1–64. This file records all 63 canonical subsections in Simanim 1–59; the five overlapping Simanim 60–64 remain in their already published ledger and are not counted twice. Read complete originating Hebrew sections, classify opening invocation/title separately, compare actual primary texts in both schools, and record individual approvals and rejections. New translations, exact quotations, interpretation, placement, and duplication are separately checked. Retrieval scores never constitute approval.
